onboarding.cardRoute: Pay by card → receive ETH → convert to DAI → transfer to SORA → swap for XOR.
onboarding.ethereumRoute: Convert to DAI if needed → transfer to SORA → swap for XOR.
onboarding.tonRoute: Convert TON funds to ETH → convert to DAI → transfer to SORA → swap for XOR.
onboarding.soraRoute: Swap your DAI on SORA for XOR.
onboarding.xorRoute: Use the XOR already in your SORA wallet.
onboarding.burnStep: Then review and burn XOR for future TS.
onboarding.externalApprovals: Some approvals open your wallet app or extension. Return here afterward.
onboarding.cardCheckout: Card payment opens MoonPay checkout. Availability depends on your region and its checks.
onboarding.tonAlternatives: Prefer a route with fewer wallets?
onboarding.setupIntroduction: Connect your wallets one at a time. Connecting does not send funds.
onboarding.soraPurposeXor: This is where you’ll receive and hold your XOR.
onboarding.soraPurposeTs: This wallet holds your XOR and records your burn for future TS.
onboarding.ethereumPurpose: Your Ethereum wallet holds funds before their transfer to SORA.
onboarding.tonPurpose: Connect the TON wallet that holds the funds you want to use.
onboarding.installEthereum: Install an Ethereum wallet, such as MetaMask, on your phone or browser.
onboarding.createEthereum: Create an account in that wallet and complete its recovery setup.
onboarding.returnEthereum: Return here, choose Connect Ethereum wallet, and select your wallet. On mobile, approve the connection in your wallet app.
onboarding.metamaskLink: Get MetaMask — official site (opens a new tab)
onboarding.tonHelpText: Choose your wallet in the connection window. Approve in your TON wallet app, then return here. Use a mainnet account.
onboarding.googleSummary: Create a SORA wallet or open an existing encrypted Google Drive backup.
onboarding.googleCreate: For a new wallet, choose Create account and complete the recovery phrase, password and backup steps. Then select the account to connect.
onboarding.googleRestore: For an existing backup, sign in to the same Google account, select your SORA account and enter its wallet password.
onboarding.googleRecovery: Keep your recovery phrase and wallet password. Google sign-in does not replace them.
onboarding.soraHelp: Need to create or recover a SORA wallet?
onboarding.soraHelpText: Choose a supported SORA wallet and follow its creation or recovery steps, then return here to connect it.
onboarding.soraGuide: SORA wallet guide — official site (opens a new tab)
onboarding.connectionHelp: If the connection window closed, choose the same button to try again. No transfer starts during setup.
